caption: The drawing depicts a decorative stand with a central oval mirror and two symmetrical, horn-shaped vases or holders on either side. The mirror features a blue-tinted reflective surface with angular light blue highlights and is edged with a gold and teal border. Above the mirror, there are two dark gold leaves forming a decorative accent. The mirror and vases are supported by a framework of curled, gold-toned metal with floral and leaf motifs. Each vase is decorated with hand-painted flowers in pink, blue, and green, with a pink band around the rim. Below the mirror is an oval dish bordered in pink and light blue with a gold rim. Inside the dish, there are painted blue flowers along the border and a central motif of a flying bird with red, yellow, green, and blue feathers. The entire composition has a symmetrical layout, centered on the mirror, with intricate floral and leaf designs integrated into the metal framework. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Ladies Toilet Set
